body: While a run is in flight Hatchet's workflow idempotency (STATUS method) gives atomic uniqueness; uniqueness after the run ends needs a unique index in a table. Only MemoryUnique exists today. Recommendation: a SQL UniqueStore in sqlstore, constructible from a plain *sql.DB, on its own table via a numbered migration (ADR-0005, proposed, private notes).
title: Decide: where the uniqueness table lives (uniqueness that outlives a run)
